title: Discrete Heisenberg–Weyl group and modular group
note: Verified 2026-06-23 (doth) and disambiguated 2026-11-24 (bean qou-1buz): L. D. Faddeev, 'Discrete Heisenberg–Weyl group and modular group', Lett. Math. Phys. 34, 249-254 (1995), DOI 10.1007/BF01872779, arXiv hep-th/9504111. Introduces the modular double and the integral noncompact quantum dilogarithm Phi_b (the primary source intended by noncompact archimedean DilogPart* / FaddeevQuantumDilogarithm sites that inline-cited faddeev1994). Distinct from faddeev1994 (Varenna 1994 compact S(w) lectures, hep-th/9408041) and faddeev_kashaev1994 (Mod. Phys. Lett. A 9(5), 427-434, 1994, compact q-Pochhammer pentagon).
